meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Haan 👍 Indian skin tone par **white cast avoid karne ke liye chemical/modern hybrid sunscreen** generally better rehta hai. Current options dekhkar meri top picks:

### [Minimalist Light Fluid Face Sunscreen SPF 50]()
*₹315*

### [Re'equil Ultra Matte Dry Touch Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++]()
*₹310.50*

### [The Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic Sunscreen Aqua Gel SPF 50 PA++++]()
*₹239*

### [Fixderma Shadow SPF 50+ Gel Sunscreen]()
*₹512*

### 🏆 Meri recommendation
**1. Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++ — best overall**  
Lightweight, moisturiser-jaisa texture, natural/non-shiny finish aur brand ke according white-cast free. Independent testing mein SPF 56.6 report hua hai. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/skin-body-1/products/multi-vitamin-spf-50?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**2. Re'equil Ultra Matte — oily skin ke liye best**  
Agar face oily/sweaty rehta hai, iska matte, dry-touch finish better rahega. Indian-skin sunscreen roundups mein bhi ise no/minimal-white-cast option ke roop mein recommend kiya gaya hai. [www.femina.in](https://www.femina.in/beauty/skin/amp-stories/7-best-sunscreens-that-do-not-leave-a-white-cast-on-indian-skin-286871.amp?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/these-7-sunscreens-without-white-cast-work-for-indian-skin-and-summers-101783583467308.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**3. The Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel — lightweight/budget pick**  
Gel texture, SPF 50 PA++++ aur no-white-cast claim; especially normal-to-oily skin ke liye achha option. [www.femina.in](https://www.femina.in/beauty/skin/amp-stories/7-best-sunscreens-that-do-not-leave-a-white-cast-on-indian-skin-286871.amp?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/these-7-sunscreens-without-white-cast-work-for-indian-skin-and-summers-101783583467308.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**4. Fixderma Shadow Gel — comfortable daily option**  
Gel texture aur deeper Indian skin tones par blend hone ke liye commonly recommended. [www.femina.in](https://www.femina.in/beauty/skin/amp-stories/7-best-sunscreens-that-do-not-leave-a-white-cast-on-indian-skin-286871.amp?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Agar mujhe ek hi choose karna ho:** 👉 **Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++**.

Aap mujhe bas bata do **aapki skin oily, dry, combination ya acne-prone hai**, aur budget (₹300/₹500/₹1000), main **sirf 2 best options** select karke bata dunga.
